details.fact: A photograph of a sausage dog. Written on it: "Biscuit".
details.question: What's tucked behind the little window?

details.fact: Initials pressed inside the cover: W.B.
details.question: Are there any initials on it?

details.fact: A ticket stub: Harwick to Ninefold, third class.
details.question: Where were you travelling from?

details.fact: A pressed four-leaf clover, hidden by the photograph.
A moth hole near the fringe.
details.question: Is it in good condition?

details.fact: A label sewn underneath: "Knitted with love, Nan".
details.question: Is there a label in it?

details.fact: A tiny knitted letter C in one corner.

objects.name: Green umbrella with a duck handle

details.fact: A name strip hidden under the strap: B. BRAMBLE.
details.question: Is there a name on it anywhere?

details.fact: The duck's beak has a chip out of it.
details.question: Is the handle damaged at all?

details.fact: A sherbet lemon wrapper tucked into the folds.
Stamped into the brass collar: NINEFOLD RLY.
details.question: Are there any markings on it?
details.altFact: Stamped into the brass collar: T. HALE, STATION MASTER.

details.fact: Scratched into the brass tip: A+T.

tag.note: It hums. Not my imagination. — G.

details.fact: Initials on the latch plate: O.M.
details.question: Are there any initials on it?

details.fact: Travel labels: Lisboa 1931 and Wien, Opernball 1934.
details.question: Has it travelled far?

details.fact: Inside, a lavender sachet. Still fragrant.
details.question: What's packed inside?

details.fact: A dance card from the Vienna Opera Ball. Every dance: "T."
The needle doesn't point north. It swings towards the Iron Drawer.
details.question: Does it still work?

details.fact: Engraved inside the lid: "Find what is lost".
details.question: Is there an inscription?

details.fact: Engraved underneath: a tiny map of nine railway lines.
Inside: a plum velvet cloche with an ostrich feather.
details.question: What's inside it?

details.fact: A theatre ticket: Twelfth Night, with Miss Edie Larkspur.
details.question: Were you at the theatre?

details.fact: A love letter, written and never sent.
